scope: Add officially released Dragon Duke Revenge Deck to the active permanent Equipment inventory and retain dated L1-27 data without guessing its counterattack contract.
game_version: Released August 2026; game-file table dated 2026-09-01 and claimed client build 18.600.3 updated 2026-09-18.

sources.title: The Awesome Medal Event is here!
facts: Revenge Deck was introduced as Dragon Duke Epic Hero Equipment and made available at TH15 and above in the August 2026 event Trader Shop.
sources.limitations: The event's temporary shop and temporary level boost do not make the obtained Equipment temporary; the post-event acquisition route and counterattack timing are not described.

sources.title: Revenge Deck: levels, costs and times — Clash of Clans
sources.version: Game-file data dated 2026-09-01, processed 2026-09-03; exact client build unpublished
facts: Epic Dragon Duke Equipment has maximum level 27; the page lists per-level ore costs and Blacksmith requirements, with totals 56060 Shiny, 3720 Glowy and 480 Starry Ore.
sources.limitations: No per-level heal or counter damage, trigger eligibility, cooldown, damage phase or interaction ordering is provided.

sources.title: Revenge Deck — Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.version: Client build 18.600.3 as claimed by source
facts: The L1-27 hitpoint boosts run from 900 to 3200, with ore costs and Blacksmith requirements agreeing with GiBiArena; the short ability description says defenders striking Dragon Duke are dealt a painful hand.
sources.limitations: The page does not supply numeric counter damage, healing, hit eligibility, cooldown or event ordering. Its broader Equipment index also lists Portal Pendant without confirming a release date.

sources.title: Clash of Clans upgrade data
facts: The dated index includes Revenge Deck in its 42 listed Equipment entries.
sources.limitations: An index is not a full combat contract or proof that other game-file-only entries have been released.

sources.title: Hero Equipment — Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.version: Client build 18.600.3 as claimed by source
facts: The game-file-derived index contains Portal Pendant in addition to Revenge Deck, yielding 43 entries.
sources.limitations: No checked official source confirms Portal Pendant was released or obtainable by 2026-09-23, so it is not included in the current permanent roster.

derivations.result: Add one Equipment item to the active 41-item inventory, yielding 42
derivations.method: Supercell release confirmation plus two dated game-file indexes; the frozen 2026-09-17 roster remains unchanged.

derivations.result: Retain the dated L1-27 hitpoint boost, ore costs and Blacksmith requirements
derivations.method: Lossless transcription into the SHA-pinned observation; cross-check costs and requirements against GiBiArena. No counter damage or healing amount inferred.

rejected_inferences.rule: Treat Portal Pendant as released permanent Equipment
rejected_inferences.reason: One game-file index lists it, but no checked official release or availability notice confirms it by 2026-09-23; the independent dated index omits it.

rejected_inferences.rule: Treat the August event's temporary maximum-level boost as a permanent level state
rejected_inferences.reason: The boost applied August 26-31, while the item has its own upgrade levels.

rejected_inferences.rule: Implement automatic reflected damage or healing on every hit
rejected_inferences.reason: No checked source gives the amount, trigger eligibility, cooldown, damage phase or ordering relative to Dragon Duke, Pets and other Equipment.

rejected_inferences.rule: Use the L1-27 HP boost as a standalone Core modifier
rejected_inferences.reason: Equipment loadout, stacking, stat application and snapshot contract remain unresolved; applying the boost alone would create an incomplete combat actor.

items: current-build continuity and post-event acquisition route
numeric reflected damage and any healing at every level
hit and attacker eligibility, cooldown and counter trigger
damage, heal and death tick ordering
Dragon Duke Royal Rampage, Phoenix revival and Rocket Backpack interactions
Equipment loadout, stat stacking and adapter serialization
visual effect placement and compatible art rights
official release and obtainable status as of 2026-09-23

conclusion: Revenge Deck joins the active permanent Hero Equipment inventory as item 42 and remains partial, catalogue-only. Its sourced level data is preserved; the counterattack and loadout contracts are insufficient for a faithful Core actor. Portal Pendant is not counted without release evidence.
